intro: We hold a recorded total fee for {{count}} published BBA / BBM / BBS colleges in India. This page gathers the top BBA / BBM / BBS colleges in India with fees 2026, so you can see what a programme costs before you shortlist it.
The colleges at the top follow our verified 2026 ranking where we hold a fee. After them, colleges are ordered by recorded total fee, lowest first.
listLead: The first cards with a recorded fee include Deen Dayal Upadhyaya College in Delhi and SICSR Pune, then several colleges with figures close to ₹10,000–₹13,000. Read the programme name, and check whether that fee is one year or the full course.
snapshot: Across the {{feeN}} published colleges on this list, the median recorded total fee is {{feeMedian}}. The middle half of colleges sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
A low figure is worth a second look, especially at the ₹10,000 floor we treat as the lowest quotable fee. Most colleges here are private ({{private}}), with {{public}} public institutes.
Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh and Delhi NCR have the most listings. Use the list of top BBA / BBM / BBS colleges in India 2026 as a shortlist.
firstCollegesLead: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya College, a University of Delhi campus, is listed first among colleges with a fee, with a recorded BMS fee of ₹20,430 and a 2022 average package of ₹4 lakh.

Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies is missing here because we do not yet hold a total fee for it. College of Vocational Studies shows a BMS fee of ₹10,000 in our records, which should be checked on the official notice.
Uttarakhand Open University is also on the early fee list. Confirm whether a low figure is one year or the full programme, and whether the college is a regular or an open course.

sections.heading: How these BBA colleges usually admit students
paragraphs: Delhi University BMS and BBA (FIA) seats, including those at SSCBS, are filled through CUET (UG) 2026, as the college FAQ and the DU bulletin set out. Many private colleges use their own test or Class 12 marks.
A missing well-known campus on this fee list usually means we do not hold a total fee, not that the college has closed admissions.

compare.heading: How to compare the top BBA / BBM / BBS colleges in India with fees 2026
paragraphs: Start with the award and the fee notice, because a BMS, a BBA and an integrated BBA-MBA are not priced the same way.
Then check these points on the official site:
bullets: Whether the published fee is for the full programme or for one year, and whether university or exam charges are included.
The entrance route for 2026 (CUET UG, IPMAT, a university test, or Class 12 merit) and the cut-off for your category.
Whether the college is a regular campus or an open or distance programme, which changes the teaching model.
The latest official placement report for that undergraduate programme, treated as a historical record rather than a promise.

faqs.question: How many BBA colleges in India have fees listed here?
faqs.answer: {{count}} published BBA / BBM / BBS colleges have a recorded total fee in our records, and colleges without a fee on file are not placed on this list.

faqs.question: What is the typical BBA fee in India in 2026?
faqs.answer: Among the {{feeN}} published colleges here, the median recorded total fee is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half falls between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.

faqs.question: Why is SSCBS missing from this fee list?
faqs.answer: Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies is a well-known Delhi University campus, but we do not hold a total fee for it yet, so it cannot be placed in a fee list.

faqs.question: Is a ₹10,000 fee the cheapest full BBA programme?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily, because ₹10,000 is only the lowest figure we treat as quotable, and it may be one-year tuition, so confirm the official notice before you budget.

faqs.question: How do Delhi University BBA and BMS admissions work in 2026?
faqs.answer: SSCBS and the University of Delhi bulletin say undergraduate business seats are filled through CUET (UG) 2026. Confirm the required CUET subjects in the official bulletin.
